fields.label: Require Both Schemas
fields.description: When enabled, both Evaluation Schema and Grade Schema must be mapped together. Partial mapping is not allowed.

fields.label: Allow Partial Mapping
fields.description: Allow saving with only one schema mapped. Ignored if Require Both Schemas is enabled.

fields.label: Default Evaluation Schema
fields.description: Auto pre-selected when mapping a course with no existing schema.

fields.label: Default Grade Schema
fields.description: Auto pre-selected when mapping a course with no existing schema.

fields.label: Schema Lock Date
fields.description: On and after this date, no schema changes or unmaps are allowed.

fields.label: Require Change Reason
fields.description: Force users to enter a justification when changing an already-mapped schema.

fields.label: Lock Override Role
fields.description: Users with this role can still make changes after the lock date.

fields.label: Notification Recipients
fields.description: Comma-separated email addresses to notify on schema changes.

fields.label: Enable Change Log
fields.description: Log every schema change to Schema Change Log.

fields.label: Log Retention (Months)
fields.description: Auto-delete change log entries older than this many months.

fields.label: Re-exam Max Marks Cap (%)
fields.description: Cap re-exam score as a percentage (0 = no cap).
Allow students to apply for FA/MFA
fields.label: Allow FA/MFA Applications

fields.description: Days before exam to apply for FA (University Representation)
fields.label: FA Application Days Before Exam

fields.description: Days after exam to apply for FA with justification
fields.label: FA Application Days After Exam

fields.description: Users who can approve/reject FA/MFA applications. Only these users are allowed to change an application's status.
fields.label: Programme Chair

fields.description: Users notified by email whenever a student raises an FA/MFA application, for visibility only — they cannot approve/reject.
fields.label: AAD Team

fields.description: Email Template used to notify the Programme Chair(s) and AAD Team when a student raises an FA/MFA application.
fields.label: FA/MFA Notification Email Template
Courses Per Page
fields.description: Maximum courses loaded in the schema mapping overlay.

fields.label: Show Unmapped Courses
fields.description: Show courses with no schema in the mapping table by default.
